sloka: तत्र सीते मया सार्धम् वनेषु विचरिष्यसि ।न च अस्य वन वासस्य स्पृहयिष्यसि भामिनि ॥३-४७-३०॥
transliteration: tatra sīte mayā sārdham vaneṣu vicariṣyasi ।na ca asya vana vāsasya spṛhayiṣyasi bhāmini ॥3-47-30॥

translations.english: O Sita, you can stroll with me in my pleasuregardens. O beautiful lady, you will not like living in the forest (thereafter).
